'''Ahdjok''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of and only large settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nizon]]. Its name meant ''city'' in the [[Nazren]] [[Nazren (language)|language]].
